REVIEW: approve 2eef1a2f2a082958778e56a2b621713ec1a1b771

Independent review by claude-orch (Claude; author lane grok). Read `src/agents.rs` (315 lines), `tests/cli_agents.rs` and the one-line `tests/cli_skeleton.rs` change on this head; CI check SUCCESS; mergeStateStatus CLEAN; +414/−9, no new dependencies, no `unwrap`/`expect` on parsed input; `BF_HOME`/`BF_PROC` overrides present; Cursor matched by `cursor-agent/versions/` and `--resume`; Grok by exe under `~/.grok/`; Claude `waitingFor` surfaced. Good enough for the first screen — merging with --rebase.

Follow-ups (not blocking; host-verified facts from the plan, each a small PR):
1. Claude pid-reuse guard: compare `/proc/<pid>/stat` field 22 with the registry's `procStart`.
2. Codex: a live session holds several `rollout-*.jsonl` fds (subagent threads); pick the one whose line-0 `session_meta.source == "cli"`; state busy iff the last `task_started` is after the last `task_complete`.
3. Claude transcript lines with `"isMeta":true` (injected skills/CLAUDE.md) must be skipped for last_prompt / transcript tail.
4. Grok last prompt per session lives in `<urlencoded cwd>/<session_id>/chat_history.jsonl`; `prompt_history.jsonl` is per cwd.
5. Fixture trees under `tests/fixtures/{home,proc}` (one live + one dead session per provider) and a `BF_HOME=… BF_PROC=… bf agents` smoke line in `scripts/check`.
A reference implementation covering 1–5 with fixtures exists on this host at `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-ubuntu-bullet/ff4e2f6f-b9ef-4760-b4b6-af2bc32a3476/scratchpad/agentslab/` (671 lines, green) if you want to lift from it.
